description: Single storey rear infill extension with roof light, replacement of boundary wall and timber gate, replacement of rear outbuilding, painting existing render and creation of rain garden for SuDS.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Design and Access Statement - Rev A E-100 - EXISTING: SITE LOCATION PLANSE-101 - EXISTING: PLANS, ELEVATIONS & SECTIONSPD-101 Rev: D - PLANS, ELEVATIONS & SECTIONSP-102 Rev: B - EXISTING + PROPOSED: OUTBUILDINGP-103 - EXISTING + PROPOSED: ROOF PLANSP-104 Rev: D - EXISTING + PROPOSED: GROUND FLOOR PLAN WITH FLOOR LEVELSP-105 Rev: D - EXISTING + PROPOSED: HARD AND SOFT LANDSCAPINGP-106 Rev: E - PROPOSED: RAINWATER GARDEN DETAILSSuDS proformaFlood Risk Assessment and Detailed Drainage Design  - R1018 - Rev - V2.1 dated June 2026Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application.Reason: To ensure a design which complies with Development Plan Policies.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time. Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.

Prior to occupation of the development, a Verification Report demonstrating that the approved SuDS and Flood Risk measures have been fully implemented shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. This report must include:o	As built drawings of the sustainable drainage systems including level information (if appropriate)o	Photographs of the completed sustainable drainage systemso	Any relevant certificates from manufacturers/ suppliers of any drainage featureso	A confirmation statement of the above signed by the site manager or similarReason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 59-62, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF.
